targetTexts.1: And David sang this song to the LORD on the day the LORD had delivered him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul.
targetTexts.2: He said: “The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer.
targetTexts.3: My God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield, and the horn of my salvation. My stronghold, my refuge, and my Savior, You save me from violence.
targetTexts.4: I will call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; so shall I be saved from my enemies.
targetTexts.5: For the waves of death engulfed me; the torrents of chaos overwhelmed me.
targetTexts.6: The cords of Sheol entangled me; the snares of death confronted me.
targetTexts.7: In my distress I called upon the LORD; I cried out to my God. And from His temple He heard my voice, and my cry for help reached His ears.
targetTexts.8: Then the earth shook and quaked; the foundations of the heavens trembled; they were shaken because He burned with anger.
targetTexts.9: Smoke rose from His nostrils, and consuming fire came from His mouth; glowing coals blazed forth.
targetTexts.10: He parted the heavens and came down with dark clouds beneath His feet.
targetTexts.11: He mounted a cherub and flew; He soared on the wings of the wind.
targetTexts.12: He made darkness a canopy around Him, a gathering of water and thick clouds.
targetTexts.13: From the brightness of His presence coals of fire blazed forth.
targetTexts.14: The LORD thundered from heaven; the voice of the Most High resounded.
targetTexts.15: He shot His arrows and scattered the foes; He hurled lightning and routed them.
targetTexts.16: The channels of the sea appeared, and the foundations of the world were exposed at the rebuke of the LORD, at the blast of the breath of His nostrils.
targetTexts.17: He reached down from on high and took hold of me; He drew me out of deep waters.
targetTexts.18: He rescued me from my powerful enemy, from foes too mighty for me.
targetTexts.19: They confronted me in my day of calamity, but the LORD was my support.
targetTexts.20: He brought me out into the open; He rescued me because He delighted in me.
targetTexts.21: The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness; He has repaid me according to the cleanness of my hands.
targetTexts.22: For I have kept the ways of the LORD and have not wickedly departed from my God.
targetTexts.23: For all His ordinances are before me; I have not disregarded His statutes.
targetTexts.24: And I have been blameless before Him and kept myself from iniquity.
targetTexts.25: So the LORD has repaid me according to my righteousness, according to my cleanness in His sight.
targetTexts.26: To the faithful You show Yourself faithful, to the blameless You show Yourself blameless;
targetTexts.27: to the pure You show Yourself pure, but to the crooked You show Yourself shrewd.
targetTexts.28: You save an afflicted people, but Your eyes are on the haughty to bring them down.
targetTexts.29: For You, O LORD, are my lamp; the LORD lights up my darkness.
targetTexts.30: For in You I can charge an army; with my God I can scale a wall.
targetTexts.31: As for God, His way is perfect; the word of the LORD is flawless. He is a shield to all who take refuge in Him.
targetTexts.32: For who is God besides the LORD? And who is the Rock except our God?
targetTexts.33: God is my strong fortress, and He makes my way clear.
targetTexts.34: He makes my feet like those of a deer and stations me upon the heights.
targetTexts.35: He trains my hands for battle; my arms can bend a bow of bronze.
targetTexts.36: You have given me Your shield of salvation, and Your gentleness exalts me.
targetTexts.37: You broaden the path beneath me so that my ankles do not give way.
targetTexts.38: I pursued my enemies and destroyed them; I did not turn back until they were consumed.
targetTexts.39: I devoured and crushed them so they could not rise; they have fallen under my feet.
targetTexts.40: You have armed me with strength for battle; You have subdued my foes beneath me.
targetTexts.41: You have made my enemies retreat before me; I destroyed those who hated me.
targetTexts.42: They looked, but there was no one to save them—to the LORD, but He did not answer.
targetTexts.43: I ground them as the dust of the earth; I crushed and trampled them like mud in the streets.
targetTexts.44: You have delivered me from the strife of my people; You have preserved me as the head of nations; a people I had not known shall serve me.
targetTexts.45: Foreigners cower before me; when they hear me, they obey me.
targetTexts.46: Foreigners lose heart and come trembling from their strongholds.
targetTexts.47: The LORD lives, and blessed be my Rock! And may God, the Rock of my salvation, be exalted—
targetTexts.48: the God who avenges me and brings down nations beneath me,
targetTexts.49: who frees me from my enemies. You exalt me above my foes; You rescue me from violent men.
targetTexts.50: Therefore I will praise You, O LORD, among the nations; I will sing praises to Your name.
targetTexts.51: Great salvation He brings to His king. He shows loving devotion to His anointed, to David and his descendants forever.”
